audit.whatIsWrong: All full-layer phases[N].side read 'Skill' for every row, but content win[N] and packet.levelChart both give Tristana rows 1-2 and Xayah the other five.
audit.why: Rocket Jump (W) plus Explosive Charge (E) gives Tristana a mobile lvl 2-3 all-in per her kit; Xayah's kit and items flip it at level 1 and from 4-5 onward. content whys[1-2] already describe the Tristana-favored reasoning; full-layer why for those rows was still written as if Xayah won.
audit.corrected: Set phases[1].side/[2].side to Tristana and rewrote their why text to the Tristana-favored reasoning; set phases[0],[3-6].side to Xayah (their why text already agreed with an Xayah-favorable verdict, so left as-is).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns calls Rocket Jump matchup-defining but gives no cooldown number.
audit.why: Rocket Jump (W) is 22/20/18/16/14s — a concrete number for tracking when it's safe to step up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields call Tristana 'he/him/his' (she/her per champ-gender.js); dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles instead of content matching those titles.
audit.why: Lint flagged 8 misgendered fields plus the two bleed fields — 'Root the committed engage' should describe baiting Rocket Jump, and 'R the poke instead of the dive' should describe reserving Featherstorm for her all-in, not generic feather-call impatience.
audit.corrected: Swapped pronouns to her/she across all flagged fields; rewrote dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d to match their own titles.
